propositions: _collect_node_ids launches nested pytest collection subprocess without --basetemp, causing its session cleanup to operate on the shared numbered temp root
pytest session shutdown in cleanup_numbered_dir can delete or stall on concurrent test run temp trees when multiple processes share the same numbered root
nested collection subprocess must be passed a caller-owned private --basetemp directory to isolate temp cleanup and prevent interference with sibling pytest runs
The regression test proves that without private basetemp, preexisting sentinels in the shared numbered root are deleted or traversed during cleanup
Adding --basetemp to _collect_node_ids must preserve collection selection, stdout parsing, return-code contract (0/5), and timeout (300s)
